import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from Bio import SeqIO
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import record,check
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import write_json
repo=Path.cwd();root=repo/"benchmarks/results/search_stage_probe_r1_v1_20261013";path=root/"report.json"
r=json.loads(path.read_text())
assert r["status"]=="complete_label_free_search_stage_probe_byte_equivalent" and len(r["cases"])==6 and not r["truth_labels_loaded"]
for pin in [*r["checked"],*r["runtime"]["files"]]: check(pin)
live=json.loads(Path(r["live_search_plan"]["path"]).read_text())
case=next(c for c in live["cases"] if c["dataset"]=="QfO" and c["label"]=="control100")
pins={Path(p["path"]).name:p for p in case["inputs"]}
selected=sorted(pins,key=lambda name:(hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest(),name))[:3]
assert r["selected_species"]==selected
ids={};lengths={}
for name in selected:
    records=list(SeqIO.parse(pins[name]["path"],"fasta"))
    ids[name]=[s.id for s in records];lengths[name]=[len(s) for s in records]
    assert len(ids[name])==len(set(ids[name]))==r["fasta_load_costs"][name]["genes"]
    assert sum(lengths[name])==r["fasta_load_costs"][name]["residues"]
strata=[];totals=defaultdict(lambda:{"candidates":0,"significant_hits":0})
for i,name in enumerate(selected):
    target=selected[(i+1)%3]
    indices=sorted(sorted(range(len(ids[name])),key=lambda j:(hashlib.sha256(ids[name][j].encode()).hexdigest(),ids[name][j]))[:32])
    for cap in (100,400):
        row=next(c for c in r["cases"] if c["query_species"]==name and c["target_species"]==target and c["candidate_cap"]==cap)
        assert row["original_query_indices"]==indices and row["selected_query_ids"]==[ids[name][j] for j in indices]
        assert row["query_lengths"]==[lengths[name][j] for j in indices] and row["target_genes"]==len(ids[target])
        a,b=row["runs"];assert a["instrumented"] is False and b["instrumented"] is True
        assert a["fingerprint"]==b["fingerprint"] and row["instrumentation_byte_equivalent"] is True
        assert a["significant_hits"]==b["significant_hits"]
        stages=b["inclusive_stages"]
        assert all(s["calls"]==1 and s["wall_s"]>=0 and s["process_cpu_s"]>=0 for s in stages.values())
        v=stages["batch_viterbi_multipair_c"]["wall_s"]/b["wall_s"]
        prof=stages["build_profiles_batch"]["wall_s"]/b["wall_s"]
        strata.append({"query":name,"target":target,"cap":cap,"viterbi_fraction_of_instrumented_wall":v,"profile_build_fraction_of_instrumented_wall":prof,"candidate_count":b["fingerprint"]["candidate_count"],"significant_hits":b["significant_hits"],"stage_wall_s":{k:s["wall_s"] for k,s in stages.items()}})
        totals[cap]["candidates"]+=b["fingerprint"]["candidate_count"];totals[cap]["significant_hits"]+=b["significant_hits"]
assert totals[100]=={"candidates":9600,"significant_hits":26} and totals[400]=={"candidates":38400,"significant_hits":32}
for pin in [*r["checked"],*r["runtime"]["files"]]: check(pin)
out=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/search_stage_probe_independent_readback_20261013.json";assert not out.exists()

print(json.dumps({"verified":True,"cap_totals":totals,"viterbi_wall_fraction_range":[min(s["viterbi_fraction_of_instrumented_wall"] for s in strata),max(s["viterbi_fraction_of_instrumented_wall"] for s in strata)],"profile_build_max_fraction":max(s["profile_build_fraction_of_instrumented_wall"] for s in strata)}))
